author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
Some of you saw the map pics already, but now I'm making the official map submission thread. 

Title: Travincal II
Created By: resepignev
Game: Nexus
Teams: Blue, Green, Red and Yellow
Details: The two layer map Travincal II is like the old Travincal Map. As I said it's a two layer map with a big hole in the middle. The colors are the same too. The difference is that the map has pillars instead of hiding walls for faster Gameplay. The spawns are in the top layer near the stairs to the bottom layer.
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/5006aaar4yrezo5/Travincal_II.zip
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/my4rz
YML: http://pastebin.com/R7AryErq
Screenshots:

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Honestly the map isn't that good IMO. The layout isn't bad but the block palette could be hugely improved.

I really like the height differences in the map and multiple layers but if you replaced glowstone with always-on lamps, changed the wool to hardened clay and use something instead of the coal blocks it would be a lot better.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: Heey I understand what you are pointing out. But the map is meant to be simple. And it's the second version of the original Travincal. If the always on redstonelamps get updated, there would be no light and I built the map original with an other recourcepack, so the wool and the coal looked perfectly.
